notes: Mirrors the card pages; if they disagree the card page wins. decode_tps/prefill_tps are tokens per second for one request unless streams>1 (then summed). status: measured | unpublished-code (the build includes changes not in public branches). quality_on_this_build: false marks a result whose quality check ran on another build, card or configuration than the speed figure (its conditions and quality text say which); absent means the check ran on the configuration the result names. A result that needs several cards lists them all in cards; card is the one whose page it cites. workload: bench (fixed prompts, one request at a time), agent-served (per-request decode measured while serving a coding agent; the agent's wall time also holds prompt reading and tool time), synthetic-many-agents (every agent reads one prompt once, then writes: decode capacity, not what agents doing real work get), agent-replay (recorded coding-agent sessions replayed with their own prompts, outputs and tool time; agent_useful_tps is output tokens over the measured window, summed over agents). agent_useful_tps: what agents got, prompt reading and tool time included.
